qualifier: B cell, dendritic cell and T cell
name: B cell, dendritic cell and T cell surface signatures
rationale: Members are surface-marker signatures of B cells, LPS-activated and resting DCs and Th1 CD4 T cells plus butyrophilin and exosome surface biology; the B cell signatures separate it from DC/antigen-presentation confusables and the DC/T cell signatures from the B-cell-only confusable.

qualifier: midline Slit-Robo, netrin and ephrin cues
name: Midline axon guidance by Slit-Robo, netrin and ephrin cues
rationale: All members concern axon guidance receptors (ROBO, DCC/netrin, EPH, L1/CHL1) and their Rho-GTPase effectors; commissural midline crossing and Slit-Robo signaling distinguish it from semaphorin- and DSCAM-dominated guidance confusables.

name: Renal epithelial urate and cystine transport
rationale: Members are plasma-membrane SLC carriers in kidney/liver epithelia, centred on urate (SLC2A9, SLC22A12) and cystine (SLC3A1, SLC7A9) transport and their reabsorption disorders, which distinguishes it from organic cation, hexose and neutral amino acid transport confusables.

name: Presynaptic calcium modulation of glutamate release
rationale: All members regulate transmitter release at the presynaptic terminal via calcium entry and vesicle exocytosis, with emphasis on glutamate secretion, which separates it from GABA-secretion, active-zone priming and G-protein presynaptic inhibition confusables.

name: Glycolysis and gluconeogenesis with fructose and glycerol metabolism
rationale: Members cover central glycolytic/gluconeogenic carbon flux and its feeders (fructose, glycerol/alditols, alanine, oxaloacetate, phosphocreatine); fructose and glycerol metabolism distinguish it from glycogen and hexose-transport confusables.

name: Centromeric sister chromatid cohesion and its resolution
rationale: All members concern establishing, maintaining (centromeric, mitotic and meiotic) and resolving sister chromatid cohesion leading to separation, distinguishing it from condensation, CENP-A deposition and spindle checkpoint confusables.

name: PTK6 kinase and Hippo-YAP/TAZ signaling
rationale: Members are PTK6 (BRK) signaling events and Hippo/YAP-TAZ cell-density signaling; the Hippo-YAP arm is absent from all confusables, which instead carry MET, ERBB or PI3K-AKT receptor signaling.

name: SLC26 anion exchange and epithelial small-solute transport
rationale: Members are transmembrane transport of inorganic anions via SLC26 (sulfate, oxalate, iodide, chloride) plus pyruvate, alpha-ketoglutarate, water and gap-junction transfer; these distinguish it from bicarbonate, CFTR and cation-chloride cotransporter confusables.

name: Microglial activation and apoptotic cell engulfment
rationale: Members describe microglial differentiation, activation, proliferation and DAP12-linked phagocytic clearance of apoptotic cells in the brain, distinguishing it from amyloid-beta clearance and macrophage fusion confusables.

name: RIG-I/MDA5 antiviral interferon induction and ISG15 modification
rationale: Members are cytosolic RNA sensing by RIG-I/MDA5 through TRAF3/TRAF6 to IRF/NF-kB, its viral evasion and ISG15 conjugation; ISG15 and RLR signaling distinguish it from IFN-response signatures and broader DNA/TLR sensing confusables.

name: Golgi to lysosome and late endosome retrograde trafficking
rationale: All members concern traffic between the trans-Golgi and late endosomes/lysosomes in both directions and Golgi retention, distinguishing it from COPI Golgi-ER and early-endosome confusables.

name: NOTCH1 intracellular signaling and oncogenic activating mutants
rationale: Members are NOTCH1 activation, NICD1 nuclear signaling and constitutive signaling by HD/PEST, translocation and FBXW7-loss mutants, distinguishing it from NOTCH2-4 and generic Notch target confusables.

name: B cell proliferation and differentiation
rationale: All members concern B cell development, proliferation and differentiation (including B-1 cells), distinguishing it from BCR signaling, homeostasis and germinal center/memory confusables.

name: Postsynaptic AMPA and kainate receptor activity and clustering
rationale: Members concern AMPA and kainate receptor activation, diffusion trapping and clustering in excitatory transmission and kainate excitotoxicity, distinguishing it from presynaptic kainate and NMDA receptor confusables.

name: Hyperosmotic salt response and sodium import regulation
rationale: Members cover osmosensing, hyperosmotic and salt stress responses and aldosterone/renin-linked control of sodium import; hyperosmotic sensing and sodium restraint distinguish it from hypotonic, potassium and renal blood-volume confusables.

name: RAS-RAF-ERK activation and phosphatase-mediated feedback inactivation
rationale: Members span RAS/MRAS-SHOC2 driven RAF activation and ERK/RSK signaling together with ERK dephosphorylation and negative feedback, which distinguishes it from RAS GAP, BRAF mutant and IGF1R/SHC confusables.

name: Proximal tubule organic cation, anion and dicarboxylate transport
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated organic cation, organic anion and sodium-coupled di/tricarboxylate (pyruvate, alpha-ketoglutarate) transport tied to proximal tubule development; organic cation transport distinguishes it from succinate/citrate and xenobiotic export confusables.

core: Activin and TGF-beta family signaling regulation
name: Betaglycan co-receptor and follistatin regulation of activin signaling
rationale: Members are TGFBR3 regulation of TGF-beta, activin and FGF2 signaling and follistatin antagonism of activin, distinguishing it from gonadotropin, SMAD transcription and cancer-mutant TGF-beta confusables.

name: Dolichol-phosphate and nucleotide sugar synthesis for glycosylation
rationale: Members synthesize dolichyl phosphate, UDP-GlcNAc, UDP-glucose and CMP-sialic acid donors and their disorders, feeding N-glycosylation and GPI anchoring; precursor synthesis distinguishes it from N-glycan processing, CDG enzyme and nucleotide-sugar transport confusables.

core: Hepatic organic anion and drug transport
name: Hepatic organic anion, bilirubin and drug transport
rationale: Members cover SLCO/ABCC2 organic anion and xenobiotic transport, drug ADME, heme degradation and bilirubin glucuronidation disorders, distinguishing it from bile acid synthesis/transport and phase II sulfonation confusables.

name: Morquio syndrome (mucopolysaccharidosis type IV)
rationale: All three members are Morquio A/B subtypes of MPS IV, distinguishing it from Hurler, Hunter, Sanfilippo and keratan sulfate biosynthesis confusables.

name: Replication-coupled cohesin loading and cohesion establishment
rationale: Members link DNA replication (unwinding, polymerase activity, break-induced replication) with cohesin loading and establishment of sister chromatid cohesion, distinguishing it from E2F/replication initiation and cohesion resolution confusables.

name: Somitogenesis and embryonic limb and joint morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover somite specification, segmentation clock and axis elongation plus limb, digit and joint morphogenesis; the limb/joint members distinguish it from Hox, neural plate and nodal patterning confusables.

name: Immediate-early stress gene response to UV and mitogens
rationale: Members are UV-B, phorbol ester, TNF/NF-kB and growth-factor-induced NR4A immediate-early gene programmes with growth arrest; UV and PMA responses distinguish it from senescence, AP-1 and PI3K confusables.

name: tRNA aminoacylation, tRNA modification and translation factor hydroxylation
rationale: Members cover cytosolic/mitochondrial tRNA charging, anticodon wobble modifications including wybutosine, and modifications of translation proteins (diphthamide on EEF2, lysyl hydroxylation); these distinguish it from RNA methylation/pseudouridylation and hypusine confusables.
